references.text: Balak builds seven altars and offers a bull and a ram on each altar, just as in this verse. This shows the repeated pattern of Balak's obedience to Balaam's instructions regarding sacrifices.
Balak takes Balaam to another place and sacrifices in the same way, with a bull and a ram on each altar. This is the second of three similar sacrificial acts.
The immediate context where Balak takes Balaam to the top of Peor and Balaam instructs him to build seven altars and prepare seven bulls and seven rams.
Balak sacrifices cattle and sheep earlier in the story, which shows his willingness to use sacrifices in connection with Balaam.
